IconSizeContext.description: Controls (Button, Input, Menu item…) set the icon size for icons inside them.

Spinner.description: A small ring that spins. Inherits the text color unless `tone="muted"`.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px. Match the text beside it: 12 for captions, 14 for body.

props.name: label
props.description: Announced to screen readers. Pass "" when visible text already says it.

Text.description: Every piece of text. Pick a variant for size, a tone for emphasis — never raw font sizes.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Clamp to N lines with an ellipsis.

Heading.description: A heading with the right element for its level. `level` sets semantics; `variant` can change the look.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Clamp to N lines with an ellipsis.

Kbd.description: A key, drawn like a key.

Code.description: Inline monospace value — ids, keys, file names.

CodeBlock.description: Multi-line code with optional title, line numbers, highlights, diff marks and copy.

props.name: diff
props.description: Treat lines starting with + / - as a diff.

Citation.description: A source reference in generated text: a numbered marker or a source chip, with the source on hover.

Markdown.description: Renders a safe subset of Markdown: headings, lists, code fences, quotes, rules, bold/italic/code/links, [^n] citations.

props.name: streaming
props.description: Show a blinking caret at the end while text is still arriving.

Icon.description: Renders any Keel icon with a tone and size. `tile` puts it on a small raised square (feature lists, empty states).

Avatar.description: A person or organization. Falls back to tinted initials; the tint is stable per name.

props.name: colored
props.description: Tint initials by name (default). false = neutral.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show the name in a tooltip.

AvatarGroup.description: Overlapping avatars with a "+N" for the rest.

Thumbnail.description: A small image tile — attachments, uploads, galleries. Optional remove button, loading veil and caption.

ImagePreview.description: A thumbnail that opens full size in a Lightbox.

Timer.description: Live elapsed (or remaining, with `endTime`) time: a call, a running job, a countdown.

Timestamp.description: A date or time, relative when recent ("3 min ago"), absolute after `autoAfterDays`. Full date in a tooltip.

Tag.description: A short label for a category or attribute. Ten tones; `dot` for status-like tags.

Token.description: An entity chip — a person, a team, a file — usually inside a Tokenizer or a sentence. Raised and removable.

Badge.description: A number or dot pinned to the corner of an icon/avatar (unread, alerts). Wrap the element.

CountBadge.description: A small count next to a label (tabs, nav, filters).

StatusDot.description: A colored dot for live state. `pulse` for "happening now".

StatusPill.description: A record's state — a dot and a word on a white pill. Words should be the status name ("Paid", "Overdue").

Banner.description: A page- or section-level message that stays until resolved (trial ending, sync paused).

props.name: flat
props.description: Full-bleed strip across the top of the page (no radius).

Alert.description: A raised message card inside content — a result, a warning before a form, a next step.

InlineMessage.description: One line of status beside a field or row: "Saved", "Couldn't sync".

InfoTip.description: A "?" that explains a term. Opens on click/tap (works on touch), unlike Tooltip.

ProgressBar.description: Completion of a known amount. Leave `value` undefined for indeterminate.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show "42%" (or your formatter's text) at the end of the label row.

ProgressRing.description: Circular progress for tight spots — a quota in a sidebar footer, a score.

SegmentBar.description: A score or capacity as discrete blocks. `tone="auto"`: low = danger, mid = warning, high = success.

ProgressDots.description: Position in a short sequence (tour steps, carousel pages). The current dot stretches.

Skeleton.description: A shimmering placeholder in the shape of what's loading.

SkeletonText.description: A paragraph placeholder; the last line is shorter.

Toaster.description: Wrap your app once. Toasts stack bottom-right, max 3, swipe right to dismiss.

EmptyState.description: Nothing here yet — say why, and what to do next.

props.name: actions
props.description: One primary action, at most one secondary.

StatusPage.description: A full-page error or blocking state. Plain words: what happened, what to do.

props.name: detail
props.description: Request id or timestamp, shown in mono for support.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show "42%" (or your formatter's text) at the end of the label row.

Tooltip.description: A short label on hover/focus. Never put actions or essential info in it.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint, shown dimmed after the text.

HoverCard.description: Rich preview on hover (a person, a record). Not for actions — use Popover.

DialogContent.description: A focused task that blocks the page: confirm, short form, details. Esc and the scrim close it.

props.name: footer
props.description: Buttons, right-aligned on a sunken bar. Cancel first, then the primary action.

props.name: hideTitle
props.description: Keep the title for screen readers only.

AlertDialog.description: Confirms a consequential action. Focus starts on Cancel; the action button names what happens.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Verb that names the action: "Delete 3 customers".

DrawerContent.description: A panel from the edge for record details and long forms. Floats 8px in, with rounded corners.

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Buttons next to Close: prev/next record, a MoreMenu.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Above the title: breadcrumbs, an eyebrow, a status.

props.name: scrim
props.description: Dim the page behind (default). false keeps the list usable.

DrawerSection.description: A titled block in a drawer, separated by a hairline — not a card.

BottomSheet.description: Mobile-first sheet from the bottom. Drag the handle down (or press Esc) to dismiss.

props.name: showTitle
props.description: Visible heading in the sheet. Off: title is for screen readers only.

props.name: docked
props.description: Centered, max 560px wide on larger screens instead of full width.

BottomSheetSwitcher.description: Several bottom sheets where only one is open at a time (filters → sort → share). Pass the active id.

props.name: sheets
props.type: { id: string; title: string; content: ReactNode; footer?: ReactNode }[]

CommandPalette.description: Search every action and destination. ↑/↓ move, ↵ runs, Esc closes.

Lightbox.description: Full-screen media viewer. ←/→ move, click zooms, Esc closes.

Overlay.description: Puts content over media — on hover (and keyboard focus) or always.

props.name: content
props.description: What appears on top: actions, a caption, a play button.

props.name: children
props.description: The thing being covered: an image, a card, a thumbnail.

props.name: scrim
props.description: Darken toward the bottom so white text stays readable.

Popconfirm.description: A light, inline confirmation anchored to its trigger — for reversible-but-annoying actions.

Coachmark.description: An onboarding hint anchored to one element. Chain steps with `step`/`total`. Show once per person.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Verb that names the action: "Delete 3 customers".

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Buttons next to Close: prev/next record, a MoreMenu.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Above the title: breadcrumbs, an eyebrow, a status.

props.name: scrim
props.description: Dim the page behind (default). false keeps the list usable.

ButtonGroup.description: Related actions joined into one tactile bar (Undo | Redo, Prev | Next). Children are Buttons/IconButtons with variant="ghost".

ToggleButtonGroup.description: A set of toggles in a sunken tray — formatting (B I U), view options. Single or multiple.

props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; ariaLabel?: string }[]

SegmentedControl.description: Pick one of 2–5 views. The selection is a raised knob that slides between options.

props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label?: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; ariaLabel?: string }[]

Toolbar.description: A row of tools (editor formatting, canvas tools, bulk actions). Arrow keys move between items.

DropdownMenuItem.description: One action. `destructive` turns it red; `shortcut` shows the key on the right.

MoreMenu.description: "…" button with a menu, from a list. The quickest way to add row or card actions.

CopyButton.description: Copies `value`, swaps to a check for 1.5s. Icon-only by default; pass children for a labelled button.

Button.description:
The main way to act. Tactile by design: a top highlight, a hairline ring and a soft drop;
it sinks 1px when pressed. One `primary` per view; `secondary` for everything else.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Icon or Kbd after the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Spinner in place of the content; keeps the width, sets aria-busy, blocks clicks.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render your own element (a router link) with button styles.

IconButton.description: A square button with one icon. Always labelled; shows its label as a tooltip.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — required. Also the tooltip text.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show the label as a tooltip on hover/focus. Default true; pass a string to show different text.

props.name: loading
props.description: Spinner in place of the content; keeps the width, sets aria-busy, blocks clicks.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint shown in the tooltip.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render your own element (a router link) with button styles.

Link.description: Text that navigates. Use Button for actions. `external` opens a new tab and shows ↗.

ToggleButton.description: A button that stays pressed (Bold, Pin, Follow). Sinks in when on.

props.name: label
props.description: Icon-only: pass `label` for the accessible name.

ToolbarButton.description: A tool. Pass `label` for icon-only tools (it becomes the tooltip); omit it for text tools.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show the label as a tooltip on hover/focus. Default true; pass a string to show different text.

props.name: loading
props.description: Spinner in place of the content; keeps the width, sets aria-busy, blocks clicks.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint shown in the tooltip.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render your own element (a router link) with button styles.

props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; ariaLabel?: string }[]

FieldStatus.description: One line under a control: an error, a confirmation, a warning.

Field.description:
Wires a label, description, error and count to one control — no ids by hand.
  <Field label="Company" required error={errors.company}><Input /></Field>

props.name: optional
props.description: "Optional" next to the label (use one convention per form).

props.name: help
props.description: v1 name for help text under the control.

props.name: status
props.description: A positive or cautionary status instead of an error.

props.name: count
props.description: "count / max" at the end of the help row.

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: An InfoTip next to the label.

props.name: labelAside
props.description: Element at the end of the label row ("Forgot password?").

FormLayout.description: Stacks Fields with consistent spacing. `inline` puts them on one wrapping row (filters, quick add).

FormSection.description: A titled group of fields in a long form: title + description on the left, fields on the right.

InputGroup.description: A control with attached add-ons on either side: "https://" [ domain ] ".com", or [ amount ][ Select currency ].

props.name: optional
props.description: "Optional" next to the label (use one convention per form).

props.name: help
props.description: v1 name for help text under the control.

props.name: status
props.description: A positive or cautionary status instead of an error.

props.name: count
props.description: "count / max" at the end of the help row.

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: An InfoTip next to the label.

props.name: labelAside
props.description: Element at the end of the label row ("Forgot password?").

Input.description: Single-line text. Picks up label/error wiring from a surrounding Field.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text inside the well before the value: "https://", "$".

props.name: variant
props.description: No well until hover/focus — for inline table edits and toolbars.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear (×) button when there's a value.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text inside the well before the value: "https://", "$".

props.name: variant
props.description: No well until hover/focus — for inline table edits and toolbars.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear (×) button when there's a value.

SearchInput.description: Search: magnifier, clear button, optional shortcut hint ("/").

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text inside the well before the value: "https://", "$".

props.name: variant
props.description: No well until hover/focus — for inline table edits and toolbars.

props.description: No well until hover/focus — for inline table edits and toolbars.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear (×) button when there's a value.

NumberInput.description: A number with steppers, ↑/↓ keys, clamping and optional units.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text inside the well before the value: "https://", "$".

props.name: variant
props.description: No well until hover/focus — for inline table edits and toolbars.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A clear (×) button when there's a value.

props.name: steppers
props.description: "inline" ▲▼ in the well (default), "sides" −/+ buttons around the value.

props.name: footer
props.description: Toolbar or hints under the text, inside the well.

props.name: autoGrow
props.description: Grow with the content instead of scrolling.

props.name: footer
props.description: Toolbar or hints under the text, inside the well.

props.name: autoGrow
props.description: Grow with the content instead of scrolling.

CheckboxList.description: Several checkboxes under one label. `value` is the array of checked values.

RadioList.description: Pick exactly one from a short list (≤ 6). `variant="card"` for bigger, described choices (plans).

Slider.description: Pick a value (or a range, with two values) on a continuous scale.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the current value(s) at the end.

props.name: marks
props.description: Labels under the track at these values.

Checkbox.description: A yes/no choice. `checked="indeterminate"` for "some selected". Raised box that turns accent when on.

Switch.description: On/off that takes effect immediately. Use Checkbox when a Save button applies it.

props.name: loading
props.description: Saving: a spinner in the knob, input disabled.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Label on the left, switch at the end of the row (settings lists).

RangeSlider.description: Two thumbs. Same as Slider with a two-value array.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the current value(s) at the end.

props.name: marks
props.description: Labels under the track at these values.

Stat.description: A headline number and its comparison. Every part except label and value can be turned on or off.

props.name: value
props.description: The number. `null` shows an em dash.

props.name: help
props.description: Explanation in a tooltip; gives the label a dashed underline.

props.name: action
props.description: Top-right: a MoreMenu, a "View" link, a period Select.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change vs the baseline, e.g. 6.2 for +6.2%.

props.name: lowerIsBetter
props.description: Cost, churn, latency: a drop is good.

props.name: meta
props.description: Quiet text in the delta row: "of $102.8k".

props.name: progress
props.type: { value: number; max?: number; label?: ReactNode; tone?: ProgressTone }

props.name: chart
props.description: Any small visual under the number: Sparkline, SegmentBar, BarChart.

StatGroup.description: Stats side by side, split by hairlines on one surface. Two-up on phones.

ChartLegend.description: A legend row. Optional values per item.

props.name: items
props.type: { name: string; color: string; value?: ReactNode }[]

LineChart.description: Trend over time. Hover (or touch) scrubs a crosshair with every series' value.

props.name: area
props.description: Soft gradient under the first series.

BarChart.description: Compare categories. Grouped or stacked; horizontal for long labels.

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Bars run left→right with labels on the left (rankings).

props.name: highlight
props.description: Index of a bar to emphasize; others dim.

DonutChart.description: Share of a whole (≤ 6 parts). The center shows the total, or the hovered part.

props.name: data
props.type: { name: string; value: number; color?: number }[]

Sparkline.description: A tiny trend line for tables and stats. No axes. The last point is marked.

AreaChart.description: Filled, stacked series (share of a total over time).

Thinking.description: "Thinking…" with a moving sheen and elapsed time. Click to show the reasoning if you have it.

PixelLoader.description: A grid of pixels that ripple — for "working on it" moments longer than a spinner.

LoadingState.description: A longer wait with what's happening now: pixel loader, the current step, elapsed time.

StreamingText.description: Reveals text at a reading pace with a caret — for demos and for smoothing bursty streams.

PromptBar.description: A one-line "ask AI" pill — for search pages, empty states and table headers.

ToolChips.description: Tools the assistant can use; toggle them, and see which one is running now.

ApprovalCard.description: The agent wants to do something consequential — show exactly what, and let a person approve or reject.

ConfidenceMeter.description: How sure the model is, as five bars plus a word.

RecommendationCard.description: A suggestion with its reasoning, confidence and one-click actions.

ContextCard.description: A piece of context attached to a prompt: a file, a page, a record.

InsightCard.description: A generated finding about a metric: the number, a trend, a one-line why, and a follow-up.

DiffTable.description: AI-proposed edits to records — old value struck, new value highlighted; accept or reject each, or all.

TaskList.description: An agent's plan and progress, one row per task.

ParameterCard.description: Tunable model or job settings with live values — temperature, top-p, batch size.

TaskRows.description: v1-style alias (beautifului calls these task rows).

ChatLayout.description: A full-height conversation: optional header, a thread that sticks to the newest message, the composer pinned below.

ChatMessage.description: One turn. User messages are raised bubbles on the right; assistant replies are open text on the left.

props.name: content
props.description: Markdown for assistant messages; plain text for user. Or pass children.

props.name: streaming
props.description: Show a blinking caret while the reply streams in.

props.name: sources
props.description: Sources for [^n] citations in the content.

props.name: before
props.description: Above the text: tool calls, a thinking block.

props.name: after
props.description: Under the text: a card, a chart, suggestions.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Copy / vote / retry under assistant messages.

props.name: showActions
props.description: Always show actions (not only on hover).

ChatMessageMetadata.description: Small facts under a message: time, model, tokens, sent/failed.

ChatSystemMessage.description: A neutral notice in the thread: "Ana joined", "Context was reset", a date divider.

ChatToolCalls.description: What the assistant did: each tool call with status, input and output. Collapsed to one line by default.

ChatDictationButton.description: Mic button that dictates into the composer (Web Speech API). Hidden when the browser can't.

ChatComposer.description: Where the person writes. Grows with the text; ↵ sends, ⇧↵ adds a line; attach, dictate, stop.

props.name: streaming
props.description: While a reply streams: the send button becomes Stop.

props.name: tools
props.description: Extra controls on the left of the bar: a model Select, tool toggles.

Card.description: A surface that groups related content. Use only when grouping needs a boundary — most layouts don't.

props.name: variant
props.description: card: raised surface (default). outline: hairline only. sunken: a well. raised: tactile tile. plain: no chrome.

CardHeader.description: Title row for a Card with padding="none".

ClickableCard.description: A whole card that is one action (open a record, start a template). Lifts on hover.

SelectableCard.description: A card you select (plans, templates, integrations). Ring + check when on. Use `type="radio"` inside a group for single choice.

Collapsible.description: Show/hide one section ("Advanced settings"). For several, use Accordion.

props.name: chevron
props.description: Chevron before the label (tree-like) or after (default).

Accordion.description: Several collapsible sections (FAQ, settings groups). `variant="separated"` gives each item its own card.

AccordionItem.description: One section. `meta` shows at the right of the trigger (a count, a status).

Carousel.description: A row of cards that scrolls sideways with snap. Swipe, shift+wheel, or the buttons.

props.name: slideWidth
props.description: Width of each slide: px, %, or "auto".

props.name: edgeFade
props.description: Fade the edges when there's more to scroll.

props.name: title
props.description: A title row with the buttons instead of floating ones.

Select.description: Pick one from a short known list (≤ ~12). Longer or searchable lists → Combobox.

props.name: variant
props.description: "field" = recessed like an input (forms). "button" = raised (toolbars, filters).

Combobox.description: Searchable select. With `multiple`, choices show as removable tokens in the field.

ComplexSelector.description: Rich, grouped, searchable picker — people with roles, projects with owners. Single or multiple. Raised trigger.

TypeaheadItem.description: One suggestion row — use in `renderItem` or your own lists.

Typeahead.description: Type to search, pick one suggestion. The field shows the chosen label.

props.name: source
props.description: A list to filter, or an async search.

Tokenizer.description: Several entities as tokens in one field — recipients, assignees, tags. Backspace removes the last.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Allow free text tokens on Enter / comma.

PowerSearch.description:
Structured search: pick a field → an operator → a value, as chips. Free text becomes a "contains" filter.
Good for tables with many columns (Status is Paid · Plan is not Free · "acme").

props.name: variant
props.description: "field" = recessed like an input (forms). "button" = raised (toolbars, filters).

Calendar.description: A month grid. Arrows move by day/week, PageUp/PageDown by month, Home/End to the week's edges.

props.name: outsideDays
props.description: Show days of the previous/next month (dimmed).

DateInput.description: One date in a field that opens a calendar.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts on the left of the calendar.

DateRangeInput.description: A start and end date: two months side by side, with presets. Apply commits.

TimeInput.description: A time of day from a grid of slots.

DateTimeInput.description: A date and a time side by side; `value` is one Date.

props.name: presets
props.description: Shortcuts on the left of the calendar.

SidebarProvider.description: Holds collapsed/width/mobile state. AppShell renders one for you. ⌘B / Ctrl+B toggles.

Sidebar.description: The app's main navigation. Collapses to a 56px rail (⌘B), resizable by its edge, a drawer under 1024px.

SidebarItem.description: One destination. The active item is a raised tile. Children render as an indented sub-list.

SidebarTrigger.description: The header button that collapses the rail (desktop) or opens the drawer (mobile).

TopNav.description: A product-level bar across the top: logo, primary links/menus, search and profile.

TopNavItem.description: A plain link in the TopNav.

TopNavMenu.description: A TopNav item that opens a simple list of links.

MegaMenuFeaturedCard.description: A promo tile at the end of a MegaMenu: a new feature, a guide.

MegaMenu.description: A TopNav item that opens a wide panel of grouped links, with an optional featured card.

MobileNav.description: Bottom tab bar for phones (hidden from 1024px). 3–5 destinations.

props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon: ReactNode; badge?: number }[]

Breadcrumbs.description: Where you are. The last item is the current page; long trails collapse into "…".

TabsList.description: The row of tabs. `underline` (page sections; a sliding ink bar) or `pills` (in-card views).

TabList.description: Tabs from a list, with panels. The quick way: <TabList items={[{ value, label, content }]} />.

props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label: ReactNode; content?: ReactNode; count?: number; icon?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]

Pagination.description: Move between pages of a list. Shows the range and, optionally, a rows-per-page picker.

Stepper.description: Progress through a multi-step flow. Completed steps can be clickable via `onStepClick`.

Outline.description: "On this page" — tracks the section in view and scrolls to sections on click.

FilterButton.description: A raised filter button with a count of active values.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Icon or Kbd after the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Spinner in place of the content; keeps the width, sets aria-busy, blocks clicks.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render your own element (a router link) with button styles.

FilterMenu.description: Multi-select filter in a menu, with search for long lists and a "Clear" action.

props.name: value
props.description: The value for the selected tab, if controlled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the tab to select by default, if uncontrolled

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: A function called when a new tab is selected

AppShell.description: The whole app frame: side nav + (top nav) + content. Content sits on a raised, rounded panel.

props.name: topNav
props.description: A TopNav across the top (product-level nav).

props.name: variant
props.description: inset: content floats on a rounded panel beside the sidebar (default). flush: edge to edge.

Layout.description: Regions inside a screen: header, footer, a start pane (list), an end pane (inspector) and the content.

Page.description: The scrolling body of a screen with Keel's gutters. `narrow` for forms and settings.

Header.description: The sticky top bar of a screen: title, status, actions, profile. Frosted when content scrolls under it.

props.name: status
props.description: Pill or count beside the title (hidden under 640px).

props.name: tabs
props.description: Tabs as the header's bottom edge.

PageHeading.description: A big title block at the top of a page body.

PageToolbar.description: Filters and search on the left, view options/actions on the right. Wraps on small screens.

Section.description: A titled region of a page. `variant="card"` puts it on a surface; `divided` adds a hairline on top.

Stack.description: Flexbox with a gap. VStack/HStack are the common shorthands.

Grid.description: Equal columns that collapse on small screens, or an auto-fill grid with a minimum item width.

props.name: columns
props.description: A number of equal columns, or "auto" with `minItemWidth` for a responsive grid.

props.name: cols
props.description: v1: cols (1–6) collapse to 1 column on phones.

Center.description: Centers its child on both axes (empty states, loaders).

Divider.description: A hairline between groups. `label` puts text in the middle ("or").

AspectRatio.description: Keeps media at a ratio (16/9, 1, 4/3) while filling the width.

ScrollableArea.description: A scrolling region with thin custom scrollbars. Give it a height (or let a flex parent).

ResizeHandle.description: A draggable divider. Arrow keys move it; double-click resets. Wire `onResize` to your pane size.

SplitPane.description: Two panes with a draggable divider (list | detail). Stacks on phones.

Sticky.description: Sticks to the top (or bottom) of its scroll container — table toolbars, form footers.

List.description: A vertical list of rows. `variant="card"` on a surface; `divided` adds hairlines.

ListItem.description: A row: leading avatar/icon, title + description, meta and trailing actions. Clickable when given onClick/href.

MetadataList.description: Key/value pairs for a record. Labels in a column (horizontal) or above values (stacked).

OverflowList.description: A single row of items (tags, avatars, links) that shows "+N" when they don't fit; the rest open in a popover.

TreeList.description: A hierarchy (folders, org chart, categories). Arrows move, → opens, ← closes, Space checks.

props.name: checkable
props.description: Checkboxes; parents go indeterminate when some children are checked.

props.name: showIcons
props.description: Folder/file icons when a node has none.

Timeline.description: Chronological events, newest first, on a single hairline rail. Markers can be dots, icons or avatars.

props.name: checkable
props.description: Checkboxes; parents go indeterminate when some children are checked.

props.name: showIcons
props.description: Folder/file icons when a node has none.

FileInput.description: Drag-and-drop or browse. Validates type and size before handing files to you; lists progress per file.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: You own the upload: get the files here, update `items` with progress/status.

props.name: compact
props.description: A single raised button instead of the tall drop zone.

OtpInput.description: One-time code: one box per digit, paste fills all, Backspace walks back.

Rating.description: Stars. Read-only shows the score; interactive supports arrows and hover preview.

ColorPicker.description: A brand or label color: swatches, a full picker and a hex field.

Transfer.description: Move items between two lists — permissions, columns, members. Search, select, then → / ←.

Cascader.description: Pick a leaf in a hierarchy, column by column (Region → Country → City).

InlineEdit.description: Text that turns into a field on click. Enter saves, Esc cancels; async save shows a spinner.

RichTextEditor.description: Light formatting for notes and descriptions: bold, italic, underline, strike, lists, quote, code, link. Emits HTML.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: You own the upload: get the files here, update `items` with progress/status.

props.name: compact
props.description: A single raised button instead of the tall drop zone.

TableContainer.description: Scroll wrapper. `variant="card"` (default) puts the table on a raised surface.

DataTable.description: Sort, filter, select, expand, paginate, density and column visibility — the full records table.

props.name: rowActions
props.description: Items for the "…" row menu (DropdownMenuItem elements).

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Left side of the toolbar: search, filters. The View menu sits on the right.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: While rows are selected: a floating action bar (default) or inline in the toolbar.

TableSelectionToolbar.description: What to do with the selected rows. Floats at the bottom of the screen (default) or sits inline above the table.

VisuallyHidden.description: Content for screen readers only (an icon button's extra context, a table caption).

ThemeProvider.description:
Theme state. Sets `data-theme` on <html> (tokens switch via `light-dark()`), remembers the choice,
follows the OS when mode is "system".

KeelProvider.description: Everything an app needs once at the root: theme, tooltips, toasts.
